occurrences.rationale: The surface-runtime host shim remains the same embedded IIFE at the helper-template site. Its defensive code is updated, while the injected-code role continues.

The VM-injected JSX renderer keeps its Box and Text intrinsics, flattening logic, and press handling. The strict-mode wrapper is an implementation change.
This is gh api help for the built-in GitHub proxy, including endpoint fill rules and credential boundaries. The prior graph has no corresponding help occurrence.
The artifact-library guidance continues in the same memory prompt. The CDN host changes while the UMD-build and version-pinning advice remain.
This is the Remote Control CLI help output from the same usage-reporting helper as the predecessor. Its command synopsis and option descriptions retain that identity.
The old transcript-based usage prompt remains the exact fallback at 0213. This measured-data prompt is a second branch of the same explain-usage command, so propose a split from prompt-000265.
The target and predecessor are the same host-unresponsive result builder. Changed timing values leave its command-reply failure meaning continuous.
This remains the separate lazy PostToolUse classifierContext schema description. The aggregate classifier description in 0010 and 0011 has a different callsite.
The cloud_session init-frame field keeps the same headless cloud-session documentation role and schema callsite. Its client-version and data-field guidance is a continuation of the old description.

The exact side-question wrapper remains carried at 0401. This separate You-should-know producer asks for a user-selected learning explanation; the shared one-turn, tool-free boilerplate alone does not establish identity.
This observer prompt selects a useful topic and decides whether it merits interrupting the user. It belongs to the You-should-know feature and has no prior observer occurrence.
The bundled release-history string now starts with the 2.1.289 notes. Its changelog producer and rolling release-history purpose continue from prompt-000436.
The coordinator role and multi-worker operating policy continue in the same prompt-producing return path.
The code-review output template still requests a JSON findings array. It now interpolates the result limit instead of embedding a fixed cap.
The review-report template keeps the single tool call and level/findings contract while making ranking and summary fields explicit.
The one-line finding format and empty-result behavior continue in the same review-output helper. Severity and result limits are now interpolated.
The same recall-oriented code-review prompt retains its five-plus-five angle workflow. The finding cap is supplied through a helper.
The extra-high-effort review prompt preserves its ten inline angles, deduplication, and sweep sequence. Only the cap interpolation changed.
The minimal pull-request review prompt still performs one careful diff pass. Its output cap is supplied through the shared helper.
This is the same git-commit helper context checklist at the create-commit producer. It remains separate from the adjacent Git commit and PR instruction blocks.
The Claude Code Doctor task and installation-health audit remain at the doctor command prompt site.

This is a new one-time Claude in Chrome setup offer with a setup card and extension-connectivity gate. The prior Remote Control help mentions a Chrome option but has no matching setup offer flow.
This artifact-thread instruction treats other threads and comments as information and limits work to the user-designated thread. The 2.1.285 graph has no matching thread-ownership prompt.
The prompt still tells a spawned worker to handle its task while the main session continues. Added context clarifies task ownership and execution.
The same helper describes a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Event and timeout details have expanded at that callsite.
The background-job session reminder retains its user-presence and response-tracking policy in the same agent-context builder.
This Projects write warning handles the case where a replacement left a duplicate document. It is a distinct result warning absent from the prior prompt inventory.

This gateway protocol template is the oidcConfigured alternate branch, separate from the identity-provider-enabled template.

This is new Bash-call batching guidance based on model round-trip cost, placed in the current agent instruction builder. No matching call-cost prompt appears in the prior graph.
The web-reading specialist retains the same caller and URL-reporting role. Retry and link-following details have changed within that role.

This is a new short-mode transcript summary template in the new compact-mode selector. Existing detailed and recent-summary lineages remain at their own prompts.
This is a separate word-capped summary template that combines the current context summary with mode-specific instructions. It is not the older detailed continuation prompt.
The exact no-race bullet remains carried at 0368. This adjacent expanded Background agents bullet repeats and extends that policy in the same helper, so it is the additional split occurrence.
